blocks.text: We will hold a seed swap in the library courtyard on Saturday. Anyone can bring seeds or take a packet home.
Set up three tables, one for vegetables, one for herbs, and one for flowers. Put a tray of labels beside each.
Ask each grower to write the variety and the harvest year on their packets. Add sowing instructions when available.
We have 40 empty envelopes and expect 20 visitors. That should be enough for everyone to take two packets.
If it rains, move the tables to the lobby. Leave the walkway between the door and the desk clear.
Ask for a volunteer to take the leftover seeds to the community garden on Monday.
